title: POS Payment Methods
description: Configure cash, card, and other till payment methods.

help.title: About POS Payment Methods
help.overview: A payment method is one button on the till: cash or card. Tills choose which methods they offer. Name and type are required; sequence is the order the buttons appear.

sections.title: Cash
items: Quick amounts are comma-separated values, for example 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20, shown as one-tap chips. An empty list uses the built-in chips.
Cash payments, change, cash refunds, and drawer moves update the session's expected cash.

sections.title: Card and payment terminals
sections.body: A card method can drive a bank terminal.
items: Terminal off: the cashier takes the card on a separate device and records the payment.
Manual provider: the till asks the cashier to confirm the charge on the external terminal.
Local HTTP provider: the till sends the amount to a terminal bridge at protocol, host, port, and path, with the terminal id, and waits for approval, decline, or timeout.
Test connection checks that the bridge answers before you use it at the till.

sections.title: Activate, deactivate, delete
sections.body: A till must always keep at least one payment method.
items: Deactivating hides the method from new payments and from the till assignment list.
Deactivating or deleting a method detaches it from every till; it is refused if a till would be left with no method.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
